cell_line.evidence: Immunoprecipitation (IP) was performed as previously described (ref. 2 of main document) with sera at 1/20 dilution and 200 μg HeLa nuclear extract.

disease_state.evidence: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is characterized by systemic fibrosis, vascular dysfunction, and the presence of antinuclear autoantibodies.

In order to confirm the specificity of anti-TIFIID antibodies for SSc, IP-MS was performed in healthy individuals (n=34) and in patients with idiopathic inflammatory myopathy (IIM, n=12), Sjögren’s disease (SjD, n=12), systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE, n=36) and anti-topoisomerase-I-, anti-centromere- or anti-RNA polymerase III-positive SSc (n=28).

species.evidence: Mass spectrometry data were matched against the Uniprot Homo sapiens database.
